entities.name: Uri Ilan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Uri Ilan was an Israeli soldier captured by the Syrians during Operation Zarzar on the Golan Heights who took his own life in captivity, after being captured in a covert operation. He became a symbol of courage and patriotism in Israel.
